title: Restore lost video data and fix data persistence after upgrade deploy

requirements.text: Investigate and fix the data loss issue in the backend where all previously uploaded videos were deleted/lost after deploying Version 35. Ensure the stable variable declarations and upgrade/downgrade hooks in main.mo correctly preserve video metadata and associated data (comments, likes, ratings, view counts, thumbnails) across canister upgrades.

quotes: Lagta h tumne kuch mistake kar di h upload hui sari video delete ho gai h

acceptanceCriteria: All video metadata persisted before Version 35 deploy is restored or recoverable
Canister upgrade (reinstall/upgrade) does not wipe the videos stable variable
After a subsequent deploy, existing uploaded videos remain visible on the Home and Video Gallery pages
Comments, likes, ratings, and view counts associated with videos are also preserved across upgrades

requirements.text: Audit and fix the migration.mo upgrade logic to ensure it does not accidentally reset or drop the videos, photos, comments, likes, ratings, or any other stable state when migrating from the old schema to the new schema (adding razorpayConfig and adSenseConfig fields). The migration must only add new fields and must not touch existing collections.

quotes: upload hui sari video delete ho gai h

acceptanceCriteria: migration.mo only adds razorpayConfig and adSenseConfig to the state without modifying videos, photos, comments, or other collections
Running the migration on a canister with existing data leaves all existing videos intact
No stable variable is re-initialized to an empty value during the upgrade path

requirements.text: Display a user-facing notice on the Home page and Video Gallery page informing users that a technical issue occurred during the latest update and that video restoration is in progress, to be removed once data is confirmed restored.
acceptanceCriteria: A dismissible banner or alert is shown at the top of the Home page and Video Gallery page
The banner communicates clearly that a technical issue may have affected video visibility
The banner is easy to remove from the codebase once the issue is resolved

constraints: Do not wipe or reset any stable variables during the fix — the goal is data preservation, not a fresh start
Migration logic must be additive only; no existing state fields may be dropped or re-initialized
All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor (backend/main.mo)
nonGoals: Changing Razorpay or AdSense integration logic
